name: the-forge
description: Workflow for parallel Claude Code sessions: one lead session hands tasks to worker sessions, each in its own worktree and tmux session. Skills coordinate-workers (the lead) and work-for-coordinator (each worker), a launch script, workspace templates, permission profiles, optional helper templates (comms watcher, MR watch, janitor, load check, e2e runner, tracker helper, and a scribe for teams with an LLM wiki), and an optional module-boundary lint example.
